title: Nexus
lede: Events, workshops, and community for anyone curious about entrepreneurship — no application, no commitment required.

mission.heading: The On-Ramp to Everything Else
mission.body:
Plenty of students are curious about entrepreneurship but aren't ready for a semester-long program yet. Nexus gives them a way in.

It's also where founders in Spark and Bolt come to network and get wider exposure.
